# inspect first sample forward/reverse lengths and per-position quality means at sampled points
samples=glob.glob('data/inputs/paired_input_data/*')
for sample in sorted(samples)[:2]:
    name=os.path.basename(sample)
    for d in ['forward','reverse']:
        f=os.path.join(sample,d,d+'.fastqsanger.gz')
        lengths=[]; quals=[]
        with gzip.open(f,'rt') as fh:
            i=0
            for line in fh:
                if i%4==1:
                    lengths.append(len(line.rstrip('\\n')))
                elif i%4==3:
                    q=[ord(c)-33 for c in line.rstrip('\\n')]
                    quals.append(q)
                i+=1
        maxlen=max(lengths); minlen=min(lengths)
        means=[statistics.mean([q[pos] for q in quals if len(q)>pos]) for pos in range(maxlen)]
        print(name,d,'n',len(lengths),'minmax',minlen,maxlen)
        for pos in [0,49,99,149,179,199,219,239,249]:
            if pos<len(means): print('  pos',pos+1,'meanQ',round(means[pos],1))
        print('  last positions', [round(x,1) for x in means[-10:]])
